svg.title: Amber command-line demonstration
svg.description: A sanitized terminal transcript shows Amber initialization, one reviewed memory write, attributed recall, and local store status.

text.font-family: Cascadia Code, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace

g.font-family: Cascadia Code, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
g.text: embedding: BM25-only floor (run `amber doctor --fetch-model` for semantic recall)
amber remember "first fact" store a memory
amber digest --transcripts 30d build a store from your Claude Code history
amber hooks install wire into Claude Code sessions
$ amber remember "Deploy production through a reviewed pull request." --type decision --importance 4
remembered 7pgsc364 [decision T0]: Deploy production through a reviewed pull request.
$ amber recall "How do we deploy production?" --why
1. 7pgsc364 decision T0 Deploy production through a reviewed pull request.
memories 1 total — 1 active, 0 aging, 0 superseded, 0 quarantined, 0 tombstoned
types fact 0 · preference 0 · decision 1 · event 0 · note 0
injection budget 700 tokens; no injections recorded yet
